description.value: The Viewing Tower is a public attraction located at the Alberni Harbour Quay in Port Alberni, a waterfront area on Vancouver Island. The quay is a municipal facility managed by the City of Port Alberni and serves as a focal point for visitors to the Alberni Inlet. A cycling tourist passing through Port Alberni might stop here to take in views of the inlet and surrounding mountains.
